report.summary: 4 reviewed findings turned into delivery items: enforce confirm_task contract, test guard_measurement_match completeness, audit _walk callers, and verify OS isolation for write isolation.
risks: Item 1 depends on finding OS isolation mechanisms; if none exist, risk remains medium.
Item 2 requires confirming confirm_task implementation; if it returns a new dict, the contract is already broken.
Item 3 requires identifying all callers of _walk; if none exist, the finding is moot.
Item 4 requires writing a test that may reveal false positives/negatives; effort may be high.
todos: Locate confirm_task implementation and verify mutation behavior.
Identify all callers of _walk from switches.py.
Search for OS-level isolation (worktree, container) in codebase.
Write test for node set completeness in guard_measurement_match.

items.title: Enforce confirm_task in-place mutation contract with type annotation or wrapper
items.why_now: Without enforcement, a future change to confirm_task returning a new dict silently breaks confirm_minted_task, causing data loss. Severity is critical.

steps.do: Inspect confirm_task implementation to confirm it mutates in-place. Then add a type annotation (e.g., dict -> None) or a wrapper that asserts mutation.
steps.verified_by: grep for 'def confirm_task' and check return type; then run existing tests and a new test that verifies mutation persists after call.

items.assumption: confirm_task is in a file we can locate; we assume its path is discoverable via grep.

items.title: Test guard_measurement_match node set completeness against reach.analyse and deferred links
items.why_now: The BFS in reach.py may visit nodes outside the selection, and deferred links may cause missing nodes, leading guard_measurement_match to reject valid results or miss invalid ones. Severity high.

steps.do: Write a test that creates a selection with known nodes, runs reach.analyse on a repo with weak edges, and checks if the observed node set matches the selection. Also check if any node referenced only via deferred links appears in the selection.
steps.verified_by: Test passes if the node set matches the selection and deferred-link-only nodes are absent; test fails otherwise.

items.assumption: We can locate reach.analyse and guard_measurement_match in the codebase; test infrastructure exists.

items.title: Audit all callers of _walk for correct handling of self-included parent tuple
items.why_now: If any consumer of _walk relies on parent tuples and does not account for self-inclusion, it may misbehave. Severity medium.

steps.do: Identify all callers of _walk from switches.py and verify they handle the self-included parent tuple correctly.
steps.verified_by: grep for '_walk' in codebase; for each caller, review code and if needed add a test that checks parent tuple content.

items.assumption: All callers are in Python files we can grep; we assume no callers exist outside the repo.

items.title: Verify OS-level isolation for write isolation exists or document gap
items.why_now: _paths_overlap does not check undeclared paths; if no other isolation exists, concurrent writes may conflict. Severity medium.

steps.do: Search for any OS-level isolation (e.g., worktree, container) in the codebase that prevents writing to undeclared paths. If none exists, document the gap and consider adding a note to _paths_overlap's docstring.
steps.verified_by: grep for 'worktree', 'container', 'chroot', 'namespace' in config files; if none found, add a comment to _paths_overlap docstring warning that no OS isolation is enforced.

items.assumption: OS isolation mechanisms are configured in files we can search; we assume no isolation exists if we find none.
